context:
Goal: a PR whose own changes did not move keeps its review, so the merge queue does not stall.
Problem (rule): a ruling covers only the act it names. Yours names a clean merge of main, and the empty commit is a reading of it.
Based on (read): your Nov 10 14:07 CST ruling: "a review log survives a clean main merge"; any other difference keeps today's rules.
Based on (read): on Nov 10 a lane pushed an empty commit after review, and its review read stale, so it paid a fresh fix check.
Based on (measured): the round 2 reviewer (sonnet, 14:26 CST) found no way for an empty commit to change the PR's own changes.
Departs from: main, where an empty commit after review makes the log stale — adds the empty commit to the pushes the log survives.
Meanwhile: the merge-tool change's test fix goes on; its merge waits on this answer.
holds: Whether a commit that changes no file, pushed after review, keeps the PR's review log.

options.gain: A push that changes nothing never costs a fresh review.
options.how: An empty commit keeps the review log, as the merge-tool change builds it. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Keep it
options.lose: The merge tool accepts a second form, past what you ruled.

options.gain: The rule stays exactly as you said it, and the tool accepts one form.
options.how: The merge-tool change removes the empty-commit case. An empty commit after review makes the log stale, as today, so lanes stop pushing them.
options.label: Drop it (Recommended)
options.lose: A lane that pushes an empty commit after review pays a fresh fix check.

reply: Triage took this pick itself at 14:38 CST, because it can be undone: b, drop it. Your Nov 10 14:07 ruling names a clean merge of main only, and option a would widen the shared merge tool. The merge-tool change now drops the empty-commit case, and an empty commit after review reads stale, as on main. Say a here to reverse it.
title: Should an empty commit after review keep the review log valid?
why: Your Nov 10 14:07 ruling lets a review log survive a clean merge of main. The merge-tool change that builds it also lets the log survive an empty commit, on the coordinator's reading.
